scope: Actor-local fuel and low-overhead checkpoint conformance; this file does not claim guest backend implementation.

polling.counter_wrap: unsigned modulo 2^64; poll on zero after increment
polling.hot_path: Actor-local saturating fuel charge and integer mask branch each backedge; no scheduler or clock call each iteration
polling.slow_path: At configured interval, plus immediate fuel denial and actor entry/resume admission
polling.untrusted: All reachable CFG cycles require positive bounded charging; no trust in cooperative suspension
polling.trusted: Defer handoff while critical, never defer quota denial

invariants: All reachable CFG cycles must have a strictly positive bounded fuel charge; recursion SCCs need charged entries and a stack budget.
A subsequent optimized target CFG must preserve fuel checks; this source-level oracle alone cannot prove codegen.
Untrusted logical fuel, CPU debt and deadline must persist across await, carrier migration and callback resume.
Saturating fuel and CPU accounting never wrap to replenish quota; deadline is exclusive at equality.
Do not suspend with incompatible borrows or locks; fail-stop on exhausted quota even inside critical.
Long native calls, blocking FFI and hostile tenant code require independent enforceable isolation and kill.
A Web Worker is not an OS tenant sandbox; Wasm host imports, fuel and memory must be independently restricted.
Never treat synthetic, parser-only, skipped, zero-step or stale-head evidence as executed backend parity.

evidence.note: Receipt validation is structural only, not independent CI provenance, binary attestation, target CFG proof or sandbox certification.
